Commits are unsigned by default (`use_commit_signing` available). | ✅ | [action security.md](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/security.md) |
| 1.7.10 | **Server-managed settings do not reach a CI job** authenticated with a Console API key, or with workload identity federation, or with Bedrock/Vertex. Docs' fix: deploy an endpoint `managed-settings.json` in the runner image, or use an org OAuth token. | ✅ | [server-managed-settings#platform-availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings#platform-availability) |

### 1.8 What this means for Papaya (inferences — to be used in the design)

These are my conclusions from the findings above, not documented facts:

1. **Policy layer exists and is real, but it is client-side.** Managed settings can lock bypass/auto
   mode, MCP, plugins and hooks (1.1, 1.2). The docs themselves say it is not a security boundary
   (1.1.7, 1.1.8). ⇒ Compliance's rule ("named human approves prod changes") **cannot rest on Claude
   Code settings**. It must be enforced where the agent cannot reach: AWS IAM / GitHub (Topics 2–3).
   Claude Code settings are a *safety and hygiene* layer (fewer mistakes), not the control of record.
2. **Team plan is enough for the baseline** (server-managed settings, 1.1.5). Gaps on Team: one
   policy for everyone (1.1.6) and uncertain access to the settings-change audit log (1.1.12, ⚠️).
3. **Two delivery paths are needed:** server-managed for laptops; an endpoint `managed-settings.json`
   (+ `managed-mcp.json` if exclusive MCP control is wanted) baked into CI runner images and any
   agent containers, because server-managed settings do not reach CI (1.7.10) or bypass when a
   provider env var is set (1.1.7).
4. **Defaults are permissive:** interactive sessions start in auto mode (1.2.3), sandbox is off
   (1.6.1), `-p` runs trust repo hooks/MCP (1.7.3). Each needs an explicit org setting.
5. **Bash deny rules are advisory** (1.2.6). Real prevention of "agent talks to prod AWS" must be: no
   prod credentials reachable from the agent's environment (sandbox `denyRead`/`credentials`, no prod
   profile on dev machines) plus IAM on the AWS side.

### 1.9 Open items to verify (Topic 1)

- [ ] ⚠️ Is the compliance API / audit-log export for settings changes available on the **Team**
      plan, or Enterprise only? (1.1.12) — needs Anthropic account team.
- [ ] 📖 Read the `settings-hipaa.json` example and `hipaa-setup` page (do in Topic 5).
- [ ] 📖 Open the settings-reference entries for `requiredMinimumVersion`, `allowManagedHooksOnly`,
      `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` before quoting exact semantics in `examples/`.
- [ ] ⚠️ Whether Papaya devices are under MDM (decides if `managed-mcp.json` exclusive control is
      possible on laptops). Unknown; the design must offer both paths.

# 02 — Research: what the tools can actually do today

Purpose: ground every later design decision in current, official documentation, not model memory.
Written in English (it will be quoted in `docs/`); short Vietnamese notes where useful.

## Evidence markers used in this file

This step uses the marker definitions the user set for the research phase (they are slightly
narrower than `CLAUDE.md` Rule 1, where ✅ means "verified in this environment"):

| Marker | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| ✅ | I opened and read the official page in this session; the statement paraphrases or quotes it. Where I also checked something on this machine, the line says **(local check)** |
| 📖 | From official documentation, but I did not open the specific page/section this session (e.g. known only from a link or summary), or the behaviour was not tried |
| ⚠️ | Assumption or inference, not confirmed by a source. Says what is needed to confirm it |

Rules: every claim has a link; no setting or feature name is used unless it appears in the cited
page; access dates are given per topic because these products change weekly.

Local environment for reference: Claude Code `2.1.319` (`claude --version`, **local check**).
Many documented features carry a minimum version (e.g. "requires v2.1.259 or later"); Papaya must
pin a minimum client version (see `requiredMinimumVersion` below).

### 1.1 Configuration users cannot override ("managed settings")

| # | Finding | Marker | Source |

| 1.1.1 | Precedence, highest first: **managed** → command line (`--settings`) → project local (`.claude/settings.local.json`) → shared project (`.claude/settings.json`) → user (`~/.claude/settings.json`). | 1.1.2 | List keys (e.g. `permissions.allow`) **merge** across scopes rather than override; deny from any scope beats allow from any scope. "A managed settings deny can't be overridden by `--allowedTools`." | ✅ | [settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#lists-merge-instead-of-overriding), [permissions#settings-precedence](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions#settings-precedence) |
| 1.1.3 | Four delivery mechanisms: **server-managed** (claude.ai admin console, fetched at startup, polled hourly), **MDM/OS policy** (macOS profile domain `com.anthropic.claudecode`, Windows `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\ClaudeCode`, checked every 30 min), **file** (`/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json` on Linux/WSL, `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/` on macOS, `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\` on Windows, plus a `managed-settings.d/` drop-in dir), **HKCU registry** (lowest). | ✅ | [managed-settings#choose-a-delivery-mechanism](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#choose-a-delivery-mechanism) |
| 1.1.4 | By default only **one** managed source applies per machine (server-managed first, then MDM, then file); `managedSourcesBehavior: "merge"` composes them. | ✅ | [plugins/org](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org#which-managed-source-applies-on-a-machine), [managed-settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#how-claude-code-combines-managed-sources) |

Bypass cases listed: editing/deleting the local cache, modified or older binary, **authenticating with a different org or a Console API key**, or **setting `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK` / `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX` / a non-default `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`**. | ✅ | [server-managed-settings#security-considerations](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings#security-considerations) |

Contact your Anthropic account team for access." | ✅ (exists) / ⚠️ (availability on **Team** plan not stated — ask Anthropic) | [server-managed-settings#audit-logging](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings#audit-logging) |

Users can tighten, not loosen. | ✅ | [settings#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence) |

### 1.2 Blocking permission-bypass modes

| # | Finding | Marker | Source |

The docs point to sandboxing or a PreToolUse hook for real enforcement. | ✅ | [permissions#what-a-bash-rule-doesnt-match](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions#what-a-bash-rule-doesnt-match) |

| # | Finding | Marker | Source |

| 1.3.1 | Patterns: **Disable MCP** (`managed-mcp.json` with empty map), **Fixed deployment** (`managed-mcp.json`), **Provided servers** (`managedMcpServers`, v2.1.259+), **Approved catalog** (`allowedMcpServers` + `allowManagedMcpServersOnly: true`), **Denylist** (`deniedMcpServers`). | ✅ | [managed-mcp#choose-a-pattern](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp#choose-a-pattern) |
| 1.3.2 | `managed-mcp.json` gives **exclusive control** (users cannot add servers, plugin servers and `--mcp-config` are blocked) but must be deployed to a **system path** by MDM/fleet tooling — it **cannot** come from server-managed settings. | ✅ | [managed-mcp#exclusive-control-with-managed-mcpjson](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp#exclusive-control-with-managed-mcpjson) |
| 1.3.3 | Allow/deny entries match by `serverUrl` (wildcards), `serverCommand` (exact argv) or `serverName`. **`serverName` "is not a security control"** (user-chosen label). Denylist always wins. | ✅ | [managed-mcp#match-servers-by-url-command-or-name](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp#match-servers-by-url-command-or-name) |
| 1.3.4 | Without `allowManagedMcpServersOnly`, user allowlists merge in and can **broaden** the org list. `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` does **not** enforce the MCP allowlist. | ✅ | [managed-mcp#policy-based-control-with-allowlists-and-denylists](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp#policy-based-control-with-allowlists-and-denylists) |
| 1.3.5 | In interactive sessions, project `.mcp.json` servers need approval and a cloned repo cannot pre-approve them; **in `claude -p`, SDK and cloud sessions they load without asking.** | ✅ | [mcp](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) (project scope section) |
| 1.3.6 | Anthropic "does not security-audit or manage any MCP server", including directory connectors. | ✅ | [security#mcp-security](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/security#mcp-security) |
| 1.3.7 | OpenTelemetry with `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` records which MCP servers/tools are invoked. | ✅ (stated) / 📖 (event schema not opened) | [managed-mcp#monitor-mcp-usage](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp#monitor-mcp-usage) |

### 1.4 Controlling the plugin marketplace

| # | Finding | Marker | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.4.1 | A marketplace is a git repo (can be **private**) with `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`; plugin sources: relative path, `github`, `git-subdir` (monorepo subdirectory), `url`, `archive`, `npm`, `command`. Git sources can be pinned to `ref`/`sha`. | ✅ | [plugin-marketplaces](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces#choose-a-plugin-source) |
| 1.4.2 | Org control keys (managed): `strictKnownMarketplaces` (allowlist of sources; `[]` blocks all), `blockedMarketplaces` (checked first), `extraKnownMarketplaces` + `enabledPlugins` (register and **force-enable**; `false` blocks a plugin everywhere), `disableSideloadFlags` (rejects `--plugin-dir`, `--plugin-url`, `--agents`, `--mcp-config`), `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` (blocks skills/agents/hooks/MCP not from a plugin or managed settings), `disableCommandPluginSources`, `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false`. | ✅ | [plugins/org#control-matrix](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org#control-matrix) |
| 1.4.3 | Allowlist is checked **before download and again at session start**; an installed plugin from a no-longer-allowed source stops loading. | ✅ | [plugins/org#restrict-what-users-can-install](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org#restrict-what-users-can-install) |
| 1.4.4 | Gaps the docs list themselves: no per-group targeting via server-managed settings; cannot restrict individual entries inside an allowed marketplace except via `enabledPlugins: false`; no key hides `/plugin`. | ✅ | [plugins/org#plan-for-what-managed-settings-cant-enforce](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org#plan-for-what-managed-settings-cant-enforce) |
| 1.4.5 | For CI/containers: pre-build a **seed** directory and set `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR`; seeds are read-only and still subject to the allowlist. | ✅ | [plugins/org#seed-containers-and-ci](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org#seed-containers-and-ci) |
| 1.4.6 | Telemetry: `claude_code.plugin_installed` / `claude_code.plugin_loaded` OTel events; Analytics API per-plugin counts on **Enterprise** plan. | ✅ | [plugins/org#audit-and-review](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org#audit-and-review) |

### 1.5 Controlling hooks

| # | Finding | Marker | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.5.1 | Hook events include `PreToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, `PostToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `ConfigChange`, `InstructionsLoaded`, `Stop`, among others. | ✅ | [hooks](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks) |
| 1.5.2 | A `PreToolUse` hook **blocks** a call by exiting `2` (stderr is shown to Claude) or by returning JSON `permissionDecision: "deny"`. Exit 2 blocks even if JSON says allow. Any other non-zero exit is a **non-blocking** error — the action goes ahead (i.e. hooks fail **open** on crash). | ✅ | [hooks](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks) (exit code section) |
| 1.5.3 | Hook decisions never bypass deny/ask rules; a blocking hook beats allow rules. | ✅ | [permissions#precedence-among-rules-hooks-and-mods](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions#precedence-among-rules-hooks-and-mods) |
| 1.5.4 | `allowManagedHooksOnly` (managed-only): user, project, local and plugin hooks are blocked, except hooks from plugins force-enabled in managed `enabledPlugins`. `disableAllHooks` in a lower scope **cannot** disable managed hooks. | ✅ | [hooks](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks) (enterprise controls), [managed-settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#keys-only-a-managed-source-can-set) |
| 1.5.5 | Hooks run **outside** the sandbox, "with your full access". | ✅ | [sandboxing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing) (limitations) |
| 1.5.6 | "Mods" (plugins that run JS inside Claude Code) can approve calls a deny rule refuses **unless** managed settings or a Team/Enterprise login is present; `allowManagedModsOnly` restricts them. | ✅ | [permissions#precedence-among-rules-hooks-and-mods](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions#precedence-among-rules-hooks-and-mods) |
| 1.5.7 | Docs recommend `ConfigChange` hooks to "audit or block settings changes during sessions". | ✅ | [security#team-security](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/security#team-security) |

### 1.6 Sandbox

| # | Finding | Marker | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.6.1 | Sandbox is **off by default**; runs on macOS (Seatbelt), Linux and WSL2 (`bubblewrap` + `socat`); **native Windows runs commands unsandboxed**. | ✅ | [sandboxing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing) |
| 1.6.2 | Scope: **shell commands only** (Bash, PowerShell, Monitor). File tools, web tools, hooks, local MCP servers run with full access. | ✅ | [sandboxing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing) |
| 1.6.3 | Defaults: writes limited to working dir + temp; **reads allowed for most of the machine including `~/.aws/credentials` and `~/.ssh`**; network goes through a proxy with an initially empty domain allowlist. | ✅ | [sandboxing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing) |
| 1.6.4 | Keys used for a hardened profile: `sandbox.enabled`, `sandbox.failIfUnavailable`, `sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands: false` (ignore the escape parameter), `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead`, `sandbox.credentials` (deny/mask), `sandbox.network.allowedDomains`, `sandbox.network.allowManagedDomainsOnly` (managed-only), `sandbox.excludedCommands` (excluded commands run with full access). | ✅ | [sandboxing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing), [managed-settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#keys-only-a-managed-source-can-set) |
| 1.6.5 | Env var `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` strips credentials from subprocess environments. | ✅ | [sandboxing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing) |
| 1.6.6 | Anthropic publishes a HIPAA-oriented example managed settings file (`settings-hipaa.json`, `README-hipaa.md`) with sandboxing, network allowlist and credential protections. | ✅ (link stated) / 📖 (file contents not opened yet — read in Topic 5) | [managed-settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#choose-a-delivery-mechanism), [examples/settings](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/tree/main/examples/settings) |

### 1.7 Running Claude Code in CI

| # | Finding | Marker | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.7.1 | Non-interactive: `claude -p`, with `--allowedTools`, `--disallowedTools`, `--permission-mode`, `--output-format json|stream-json`, `--json-schema`, `--max-turns`, `--max-budget-usd`. From v2.1.302 a `-p` run starts in **Manual** mode and denies anything needing approval unless a rule/hook approves it. `dontAsk` is described as "useful for locked-down CI runs". | ✅ | [headless](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless) |
| 1.7.2 | `--bare` skips auto-discovery of hooks, skills, plugins, MCP servers, CLAUDE.md; "recommended mode for scripted and SDK calls" and planned to become the default for `-p`. **But** hooks do not run in bare mode at all, so a CI guard hook needs non-bare mode. | ✅ | [headless#start-faster-with-bare-mode](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless#start-faster-with-bare-mode) |
| 1.7.3 | **Risk:** without `--bare`, a `-p` run executes the repo's `.claude/settings.json` hooks and connects its `.mcp.json` servers **even in an untrusted folder** — no trust dialog in `-p`. | ✅ | [headless](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless#start-faster-with-bare-mode), [security#additional-safeguards](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/security#additional-safeguards) |
| 1.7.4 | `--permission-prompts none` (v2.1.259+) for unattended runs: anything that would prompt is denied; denials are listed in `permission_denials`. | ✅ | [headless#turn-off-permission-prompts-in-unattended-runs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless#turn-off-permission-prompts-in-unattended-runs) |
| 1.7.5 | GitHub Action `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1`: interactive mode (`@claude` mention) or automation mode (`prompt` input); inputs include `claude_args`, `settings`, `plugin_marketplaces`, `plugins`, `use_bedrock`, `use_vertex`. | ✅ | [github-actions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions) |
| 1.7.6 | Auth options: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (tied to one person's subscription — not for shared org use), **Anthropic workload identity federation** via the workflow's GitHub OIDC token (`anthropic_federation_rule_id`, needs `id-token: write`), or **Bedrock / Vertex via OIDC** (no static cloud keys). | ✅ | [github-actions#set-up-for-an-organization](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions#set-up-for-an-organization) |
| 1.7.7 | Trigger guard: actor must have **write access**; bots rejected unless in `allowed_bots`; `allowed_non_write_users` is flagged "significant security risk". | ✅ | [github-actions#who-can-trigger-runs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions#who-can-trigger-runs), [action security.md](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/security.md) |
| 1.7.8 | The official Claude GitHub App requests a **broad** permission set (incl. Contents, Workflows, Actions write); GitHub does not allow accepting a subset. A **custom GitHub App** with Contents/Issues/Pull requests only is the documented alternative. | ✅ | [github-actions#github-app-permissions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions#github-app-permissions) |
| 1.7.9 | `pull_request_target` / `workflow_run` run with base-repo secrets: "Do not check out an untrusted ref into the workspace root before this action." Action strips HTML comments, invisible characters, hidden attributes from inputs, "but new bypass techniques may emerge." Commits are unsigned by default (`use_commit_signing` available). | ✅ | [action security.md](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/security.md) |
| 1.7.10 | **Server-managed settings do not reach a CI job** authenticated with a Console API key, or with workload identity federation, or with Bedrock/Vertex. Docs' fix: deploy an endpoint `managed-settings.json` in the runner image, or use an org OAuth token. | ✅ | [server-managed-settings#platform-availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings#platform-availability) |

### 1.8 What this means for Papaya (inferences — to be used in the design)

These are my conclusions from the findings above, not documented facts:

1. **Policy layer exists and is real, but it is client-side.** Managed settings can lock bypass/auto
   mode, MCP, plugins and hooks (1.1, 1.2). The docs themselves say it is not a security boundary
   (1.1.7, 1.1.8). ⇒ Compliance's rule ("named human approves prod changes") **cannot rest on Claude
   Code settings**. It must be enforced where the agent cannot reach: AWS IAM / GitHub (Topics 2–3).
   Claude Code settings are a *safety and hygiene* layer (fewer mistakes), not the control of record.
2. **Team plan is enough for the baseline** (server-managed settings, 1.1.5). Gaps on Team: one
   policy for everyone (1.1.6) and uncertain access to the settings-change audit log (1.1.12, ⚠️).
3. **Two delivery paths are needed:** server-managed for laptops; an endpoint `managed-settings.json`
   (+ `managed-mcp.json` if exclusive MCP control is wanted) baked into CI runner images and any
   agent containers, because server-managed settings do not reach CI (1.7.10) or bypass when a
   provider env var is set (1.1.7).
4. **Defaults are permissive:** interactive sessions start in auto mode (1.2.3), sandbox is off
   (1.6.1), `-p` runs trust repo hooks/MCP (1.7.3). Each needs an explicit org setting.
5. **Bash deny rules are advisory** (1.2.6). Real prevention of "agent talks to prod AWS" must be: no
   prod credentials reachable from the agent's environment (sandbox `denyRead`/`credentials`, no prod
   profile on dev machines) plus IAM on the AWS side.

### 1.9 Open items to verify (Topic 1)

- [ ] ⚠️ Is the compliance API / audit-log export for settings changes available on the **Team**
      plan, or Enterprise only? (1.1.12) — needs Anthropic account team.
- [ ] 📖 Read the `settings-hipaa.json` example and `hipaa-setup` page (do in Topic 5).
- [ ] 📖 Open the settings-reference entries for `requiredMinimumVersion`, `allowManagedHooksOnly`,
      `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` before quoting exact semantics in `examples/`.
- [ ] ⚠️ Whether Papaya devices are under MDM (decides if `managed-mcp.json` exclusive control is
      possible on laptops). Unknown; the design must offer both paths.

Đã xong **chủ đề 1** và ghi vào [work/02-research.md](work/02-research.md). Tôi dừng ở đây để bạn xem trước khi sang chủ đề 2.

**Cách làm:** đọc 14 trang tài liệu chính thức, ngày truy cập 2026-11-08: code.claude.com docs và `security.md` của `claude-code-action`. Có kiểm tra thêm trên máy này: Claude Code `2.1.319`, cờ `--dangerously-skip-permissions` có trong `claude --help`, và chưa có thư mục `/etc/claude-code`. Mỗi dòng trong file đều có link và marker.

**Những điểm quan trọng nhất cho thiết kế:**

1. **Có cơ chế cấu hình mà user không override được (managed settings), nhưng nó chạy ở phía client.** Tài liệu tự ghi đây là "a client-side control, not a security boundary". User có thể vượt qua bằng cách:
   - sửa cache trên máy;
   - đăng nhập bằng Console API key;
   - đặt `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK`/`VERTEX`.

   → Yêu cầu "người có tên phê duyệt" của Compliance phải được thực thi ở AWS IAM / GitHub, không đặt trên cấu hình Claude Code.
2. **Gói Team của Papaya dùng được server-managed settings** (cần role Owner). Có hai giới hạn:
   - chỉ áp được một policy cho cả tổ chức;
   - audit log cho thay đổi settings phải liên hệ Anthropic, tài liệu không nói gói Team có hay không (⚠️).
3. **Mặc định khá thoáng:**
   - session tương tác khởi động ở **auto mode**;
   - sandbox tắt;
   - `claude -p` vẫn chạy hook và `.mcp.json` của repo dù folder chưa được trust.

   Muốn đổi thì phải đặt rõ, ví dụ `permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode`/`disableAutoMode: "disable"`, `sandbox.enabled`, `--bare`.
4. **Deny rule cho Bash không phải là ranh giới bảo mật.** Ví dụ `Bash(git push *)` không chặn được `git -C . push`. Muốn chặn thật phải dùng sandbox, PreToolUse hook, và quan trọng nhất là không để credential prod trong tầm với của agent.
5. **Server-managed settings không đến được CI.** Trong CI phải dùng file `managed-settings.json` cài sẵn trong image của runner. Nên tạo GitHub App riêng thay cho app chính thức, vì app chính thức xin quyền rất rộng.

**Mục cần kiểm thêm** nằm ở §1.9. Mục chính là audit log của gói Team (⚠️).

# CLAUDE.md — Papaya DevSecOps Challenge 1

## Purpose of this repo

This repository is my submission for Papaya's **DevSecOps Challenge 1 — "DevSecOps with
Coding Agents at Papaya"** (full text: `work/00-challenge.md`). The task is to design the
framework and workflow for how Papaya uses coding agents (Claude Code) for DevSecOps,
reconciling two positions:

- Engineering: "Let Claude Code talk to AWS directly."
- Compliance: "Nothing changes in production without a named human who reviewed and approved it."

Two things make this repo unusual and shape every rule below:

1. **The complete, raw Claude Code session transcripts are part of the submission** and are
   graded. Work transparently: state the reason behind each recommendation, show trade-offs,
   and say so when something is unverified.
2. **I have no access to Papaya's systems or code**, and the challenge does not expect it.
   Everything is a design on top of the stack described in the challenge's Appendix A.

## Hard constraints from the brief

- Design for Papaya's existing stack: AWS (Lambda via Serverless Framework, ECS, EC2, Aurora
  PostgreSQL, SNS/SQS, Step Functions, S3, CloudWatch), GCP (Vertex AI, Gemini), k0s
  Kubernetes, Firebase Hosting, a single GitHub monorepo, GitHub Actions, Pulumi, Claude Code
  (Team Premium) with an internal plugin marketplace, Linear, Slack.
- **Do not propose replacing IaC or CI tooling** (no "switch Pulumi to Terraform", no "move off
  GitHub Actions"). Improve how they are used.
- Compliance context: ISO 27001 (in progress), HIPAA, regional data-protection law; multiple
  insurer tenants in different countries. Sensitive data: medical records, national IDs, bank
  accounts.

## Repository layout

| Path | Contents | Language |
|---|---|---|
| `README.md` | Entry point for graders: what the deliverable is, how to read it | English |
| `docs/` | The deliverable: framework, workflows, policies, rollout plan | English |
| `examples/` | Concrete, copy-pasteable artifacts: Claude Code settings/hooks, GitHub Actions workflows, IAM/OIDC policy sketches, plugin manifests | English |
| `diagrams/` | Architecture and workflow diagrams (source + rendered) | English labels |
| `work/` | Working notes, the challenge text (`00-challenge.md`), scratch analysis, decision log | Vietnamese or English |
| `transcripts/` | Copies of the raw Claude Code session files (`*.jsonl`) for this project, unedited | n/a |
| `CLAUDE.md` | This file | English |

Numbered prefixes (`00-`, `01-`, …) in `docs/` and `work/` define reading order. Running logs
that are not part of the reading order stay unnumbered (e.g. `work/session-log.md`).

## Rule 1 — Every claim about a tool's capability needs a source marker

The deliverable depends on what Claude Code, GitHub Actions, AWS IAM, Pulumi, k0s etc. can
actually do. Model memory is often stale. Therefore every non-trivial statement about a
feature, flag, setting, default, or limit carries one of these markers:

| Marker | Meaning | Required evidence |
|---|---|---|
| ✅ | Verified in this environment | A command run in this session with its output, or a file read here |
| 📖 | Taken from official documentation | A link to the specific doc page, ideally with the version/date |
| ⚠️ | Assumption or recollection, not verified | Say what would be needed to verify it |

Rules of use:

- Never present ⚠️ content as fact. If an assumption is load-bearing for a recommendation,
  flag it in the document as an open item to verify.
- Prefer ✅ over 📖 over ⚠️. If something can be checked locally (e.g. a Claude Code setting
  on this machine), check it.
- Keep markers in the submitted docs too, not only in work notes. Graders should be able to
  see what was verified and what was not.
- When the official docs and memory disagree, docs win; note the discrepancy.
- Do not invent product features, settings keys, CLI flags, or IAM condition keys. If a
  needed capability cannot be confirmed, design around it or mark it as a dependency.

## Rule 2 — No secrets, no personal data

- No credentials, tokens, API keys, account IDs, ARNs with real account IDs, kubeconfigs,
  private keys, or `.env` contents anywhere in this repo or in the chat. Examples use obvious
  placeholders such as `<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>` or `123456789012`.
- No personal data about real people: no names of Papaya staff, no email addresses other than
  what git already records as commit author, no customer or partner data. The challenge's
  example data categories (medical documents, national IDs) are referenced only as categories.
- Transcripts are committed unedited, as the challenge requires, so **do not paste secrets
  or personal data into the chat in the first place**. Do not print environment variables,
  settings files, or shell history without redacting values. If this rule is accidentally
  broken, stop and tell the user immediately before continuing.
- The git author identity is set repo-locally (personal address) before the first push; all
  commits were rewritten to it while still unpushed. Do not change it further.
- Accepted exception (decided session 2, 2026-11-08): the committed transcripts contain the
  author's own work email addresses (from tool output and from the context Claude Code
  injects). They are kept unedited because the challenge requires raw transcripts; no other
  person's data is involved.

## Rule 3 — Language

- **Submitted material** (`README.md`, everything in `docs/`, `examples/`, `diagrams/`,
  commit messages, code comments) is in **English**.
- **Working notes** in `work/` may be in Vietnamese or English.
- In chat, reply in the language the user writes in (currently Vietnamese), keeping technical
  terms in English.
- This file overrides the global rule that writes handover docs in Vietnamese.

## Decisions taken so far

- **Scope and assumptions (2026-11-08):** confirmed in `work/01-problem-framing.md` §6
  (rounds 1–2). In short: non-prod holds synthetic data only; prod and non-prod are separate
  AWS accounts; security of agent-written code is in scope at the PR/CI-guardrail level;
  security of Papaya's production AI agents is out of scope (noted only); all prod changes
  are approved before they are applied, including during incidents (incident approval within
  15 min, 24/7).
- **Deliverable form (2026-11-08):** Markdown docs in `docs/` plus `examples/` artifacts that
  can be validated locally. The audience is a panel of Engineering and Compliance, so every
  control states its cost to engineers and its value to compliance.
- **Branch:** everything is on `master`; no `main` branch.
- **Permission mode:** session 1 ran in auto mode. From session 2 on, sessions run in the
  default permission mode so the transcripts show the way of working the deliverable
  recommends (the challenge names "permission prompts turned off" as a problem).
- **Clean config directory:** from session 2 on, Claude Code runs with
  `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-papaya`, built by `work/setup-clean-config.sh`. It contains only
  the DevOps kit and the personal global CLAUDE.md, and disables claude.ai skill/plugin sync
  and connectors. Reason: the transcript embeds the system prompt, which lists every loaded
  skill, plugin and connector; the default profile pulls those from the user's employer
  account. Session 1's transcript still contains them; this is accepted and documented.
- **Transcript copies:** sessions under the clean profile write to
  `~/.claude-papaya/projects/<encoded-repo-path>/`; the copy command in `README.md` covers
  both locations.

## Rule 4 — Working method

- Design, don't execute: this project needs no live infrastructure. Do not run cloud CLIs,
  `kubectl`, `pulumi`, or `serverless` against any real target. Local, read-only commands
  (reading docs, listing files, validating YAML/JSON, rendering diagrams) are fine.
- Keep the challenge's two voices (Engineering vs Compliance) in view; every control should
  say what it costs engineers and what it gives compliance.
- Record decisions and discarded options in `work/` so the reasoning survives the session.
- Ask the user when a choice materially changes the deliverable; otherwise pick the sensible
  default, state it, and continue.
- Before finishing a session, remind the user to copy the current transcript into
  `transcripts/` (see `README.md` for the command).

  **1.5.2 — "hooks fail open on crash" được viết như một thuộc tính cố định. Sai cho v2.1.295+.**
  - Hook có field `onFailure: "block"` để fail closed. Hook timeout trên `PreToolUse` cũng không chặn nếu không set field này.
  - Quote: "To block the action instead, set `"onFailure": "block"` on a `command` or `http` hook. Requires Claude Code v2.1.295 or later." và "On `PreToolUse`, a timed-out … hook doesn't block the tool call, except for hooks whose failure blocks the action".
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#block-the-action-when-a-hook-fails
  - **Fix:** "Mặc định hook fail open (exit code khác 0/2, không start được, timeout → action vẫn chạy). Set `onFailure: "block"` (v2.1.295+, chỉ cho hook `command`/`http`; không áp dụng cho `Stop`/`SubagentStop`/async hook) để fail closed." Thêm dòng này vào 1.8 và vào `examples/`.
  
  **1.6.6 — Thiếu điều kiện: HIPAA configuration chỉ có trên Enterprise + BAA. Papaya đang ở Team.**
  - Quote (hipaa-setup): "The HIPAA configuration is an organization setting on Claude Enterprise plans, for organizations that handle protected health information (PHI) and have a Business Associate Agreement (BAA)…"
  - Quote (managed-settings): "If your organization has the HIPAA configuration applied, see `settings-hipaa.json`…"
  - Cùng trang: "The Claude Code extensions for VS Code and JetBrains aren't part of (local mode)… your BAA doesn't cover them."
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hipaa-setup
  - **Fix:** Ghi rõ là Enterprise-only + BAA. File example vẫn dùng làm mẫu kỹ thuật được, nhưng nó không biến Team plan thành HIPAA-ready.
  
  **1.8 #2 — "Team plan is enough for the baseline" là bước nhảy logic.**
  - Các dòng 1.1.5/1.1.6 chỉ chứng minh được rằng server-managed settings có trên Team. Chúng không chứng minh baseline cho một công ty bị HIPAA ràng buộc.
  - Trên Team không có: HIPAA configuration/BAA coverage (hipaa-setup), ZDR ("available to qualified accounts on Claude for Enterprise", https://code.claude.com/docs/en/zero-data-retention), Analytics API (1.4.6 tự ghi là Enterprise).
  - **Fix:** Viết lại thành "Team đủ cho lớp *policy kỹ thuật*. Nó không đủ cho xử lý PHI qua Claude Code. Quyết định 'agent không bao giờ thấy PHI' hay 'nâng Enterprise + BAA' là open item." Thêm vào 1.9.
  
  **1.8 #5 — Bước nhảy logic: sandbox `denyRead`/`credentials` không chặn được Read tool, hook hay MCP server.**
  - Quote: "tools such as Read, Edit, Write, WebFetch… follow permission rules instead. A `denyRead` entry doesn't stop the Read tool" và "`sandbox.credentials` affects sandboxed Bash commands only."
  - Env scrub cũng giữ lại `GITHUB_TOKEN`/`GH_TOKEN` (xem 1.6.5).
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing#what-runs-outside-the-sandbox
  - **Fix:** Thêm `Read(...)` deny rules và/hoặc `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`. Hoặc chạy cả process Claude Code trong container/devcontainer (sandboxing#scope). Điểm mấu chốt của ý 5 vẫn đúng: không để prod credentials trên máy.
  
  ### MEDIUM
  
  **1.1.4 — "only one managed source applies" là nói quá.**
  - Có cross-source keys được đọc từ *mọi* admin source: `allowManagedMcpServersOnly`, `deniedMcpServers`, `disableClaudeAiConnectors`, sandbox locks, `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`, `env` (merge theo từng biến).
  - Login keys (`forceLoginOrgUUID`) lấy từ MDM/file. `allowedProviders` lấy giao giữa các nguồn. `managed-mcp.json` được đọc riêng.
  - Quote: "A few keys work differently. Claude Code reads them from every admin source…"
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#keys-read-from-every-admin-source
  - **Fix:** Thêm "…apart from cross-source keys (list)".
  
  **1.1.9 — Thiếu caveat: `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` không đóng được lỗ bypass ở 1.1.7.**
  - Quote: "A session that doesn't fetch server-managed settings starts without waiting."
  - Nghĩa là provider env var hoặc API key của org khác vẫn bypass được.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings#enforce-fail-closed-startup
  - **Fix:** Thêm câu trên. Nhắc thêm rằng nếu `api.anthropic.com` không truy cập được thì CLI không chạy.
  
  **1.1.10 — "if the user rejects, Claude Code exits" chỉ đúng với session interactive.**
  - Quote: "A non-interactive run, such as `claude -p`, an Agent SDK session, or a session in the VS Code extension's chat panel or the desktop app's Code tab: Claude Code can't show the dialog. When the delivered settings would require approval, they apply for that run only."
  - `claudeMd` và các giá trị truthy của `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` không cần approval.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings#security-approval-dialogs
  - **Fix:** Thêm caveat interactive-only và các ngoại lệ trên.
  
  **1.1.11 — "mostly fail closed" là nói quá.**
  - Có nhiều trường hợp fail open:
    - "`requiredMinimumVersion` and `requiredMaximumVersion` fail open by design"
    - `disableAllHooks` không hợp lệ bị bỏ qua
    - `deniedMcpServers`/`blockedMarketplaces` sai toàn bộ thì bị bỏ qua
    - `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` không hợp lệ bị bỏ qua
    - "If the operating system denied the read… every session starts without that source's policies"
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#keys-that-fail-closed
  - **Fix:** Liệt kê các trường hợp fail open. Quan trọng nhất cho thiết kế: một file managed bị đặt sai quyền (OS deny) sẽ làm mất policy mà không có lỗi ở startup.
  
  **1.2.3 + 1.8 #4 — "permission prompts off is the default" sai bản chất.**
  - Auto mode không phải bypass: có classifier kiểm tra trước khi chạy, và ask/deny rules vẫn áp dụng.
  - Quote (security): "A separate classifier model reviews actions instead of you and blocks the ones it judges unsafe… Your explicit ask and deny rules still apply."

  - URL nguồn chính: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes#which-mode-a-session-starts-in
  - **Fix:** "Interactive sessions start in auto mode (classifier-gated, no routine prompts) from v2.1.283", và trích trang permission-modes làm nguồn chính.

  - permissions.md không có chuỗi `allowManagedModsOnly`.
  - Quote (mods/admin): "The option goes in managed settings under `pluginConfigs`, keyed by `cc-plugin-sec-default@builtin`" → `{"pluginConfigs":{"cc-plugin-sec-default@builtin":{"options":{"allowManagedModsOnly":true}}}}`.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/admin#stop-user-installed-mods-from-loading
  - **Fix:** Sửa cách viết key và nguồn. Thêm hệ quả: một run CI dùng API key hoặc `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` mà không có managed settings thì mod có thể override deny rule. Quote: "A session that runs on an API key or a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` instead isn't using that login". Điểm này củng cố 1.8 #3.
  
  **1.6.2 — "File tools, web tools … run with full access" không chính xác.**
  - File và web tools chịu permission rules; hooks, MCP servers và helpers mới chạy "with your full access".
  - Còn thiếu: mods, LSP, plugin monitors, lệnh gõ bằng `!` và `excludedCommands`.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing#what-runs-outside-the-sandbox
  - **Fix:** Tách thành hai nhóm như trên.
  
  **1.6.5 — Thiếu caveat quan trọng cho CI.**
  - Quote: "it leaves GitHub tokens and proxy settings in place"; "recognizes a credential by its variable name or by the shape of its value".
  - Muốn chặn GitHub token thì dùng `sandbox.credentials` deny.
  - Trang được trích (sandboxing) chỉ nhắc tên biến; chi tiết nằm ở https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars#what-the-subprocess-environment-scrub-removes
  - **Fix:** Thêm các caveat trên và sửa nguồn.
  
  **1.7.2 — Thiếu bằng chứng về việc managed settings có áp dụng trong `--bare` hay không.**
  - Docs nói hook trong settings và plugin không chạy ("Hooks still don't run in bare mode when you pass them with `--settings`…").
  - Không trang nào tôi đọc nói managed hooks, managed permission rules hay sandbox có còn hiệu lực trong bare mode. `claude --help` chỉ nói "skip hooks (those defined in settings and by installed plugins…)".
  - Bare mode "never reads OAuth credentials" → không nhận được server-managed qua OAuth token (server-managed-settings#platform-availability).
  - **Fix:** Đổi marker phần "managed policy in bare mode" sang ⚠️ và thêm vào 1.9 (cần thử trên runner).
  
  **1.7.3 — Thiếu phần còn lại của bức tranh.**
  - Trong `-p`, repo cũng cung cấp được "the `env` block and helper commands such as `apiKeyHelper`… and a project skill's hooks and `allowed-tools`".
  - Ngay cả với `--bare`: "The project's `env` block and helpers such as `awsAuthRefresh` in its settings files still apply".
  - Mitigation có trong docs: `--setting-sources user`, `--settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}'`, `disabledMcpjsonServers`.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions#what-runs-before-you-trust-a-folder
  - **Fix:** Bổ sung các điểm trên. Lưu ý thêm (xem Gaps): claude-code-action tự khôi phục `.claude/`, `.mcp.json` và `CLAUDE.md` từ base branch.
  
  **1.7.10 (mâu thuẫn với 1.7.6) — "use an org OAuth token" gây hiểu sai.**
  - Token này do một cá nhân tạo bằng `claude setup-token`, "tied to the subscription of the person who ran `claude setup-token`" (github-actions#set-up-for-an-organization).
  - Server-managed page cũng nói: "The OAuth token option doesn't apply to a job that runs with `--bare`".
  - **Fix:** "Docs give two options: a personal OAuth token authorized for the Team org (ties CI to one person; not with `--bare`) or an endpoint `managed-settings.json` on the runner." Sau đó ghi rõ trade-off với 1.7.6.

  - Quote (github-actions): "the Claude Code GitHub Action runs on GitHub-hosted runners".
  - Trên runner đó không có image riêng. File phải được ghi vào `/etc/claude-code/` trong một step, và nếu agent (Bash) có sudo trong cùng job thì nó sửa được file này. ⚠️ Tôi chưa verify việc GitHub-hosted runner có passwordless sudo.
  - **Fix:** Ghi rõ là cần self-hosted runner hoặc container image, hoặc chứng minh rằng step của agent không ghi được vào `/etc/claude-code`. Đưa vào 1.9.

  - **1.1.7:** Danh sách bypass chưa đủ. Trang còn liệt kê `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS`. Fix: thêm "…and other `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*`".
  - **1.1.13:** Nên thêm rằng `requiredMinimumVersion` fail open khi giá trị không hợp lệ, và có thêm `requiredMaximumVersion` (managed-settings#keys-that-fail-closed).

  - **1.3.1:** Bỏ sót hai pattern "Plugin servers only" (`strictPluginOnlyCustomization` với `mcp`) và "Soft allowlist" (managed-mcp#choose-a-pattern).
  - **1.3.6:** Thiếu sắc thái. Quote: "Anthropic reviews connectors against its listing criteria before adding them to the Anthropic Directory, but does not security-audit or manage any MCP server."
  - **1.4.1:** Việc pin bằng `ref`/`sha` thuộc trang marketplace-reference; plugin-marketplaces chỉ link tới đó. Fix: đổi marker phần pin sang 📖 hoặc trích marketplace-reference#plugin-sources.

  - **1.5.7:** Thêm caveat: "Claude Code doesn't run `ConfigChange` hooks when server-managed settings arrive or refresh… a hook can't block a `policy_settings` change" (server-managed-settings#security-considerations).

  - Quote (managed-settings): "If your organization has the HIPAA configuration applied, see `settings-hipaa.json`…"
  - Cùng trang: "The Claude Code extensions for VS Code and JetBrains aren't part of (local mode)… your BAA doesn't cover them."
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hipaa-setup
  - **Fix:** Ghi rõ là Enterprise-only + BAA. File example vẫn dùng làm mẫu kỹ thuật được, nhưng nó không biến Team plan thành HIPAA-ready.
  
  **1.8 #2 — "Team plan is enough for the baseline" là bước nhảy logic.**
  - Các dòng 1.1.5/1.1.6 chỉ chứng minh được rằng server-managed settings có trên Team. Chúng không chứng minh baseline cho một công ty bị HIPAA ràng buộc.
  - Trên Team không có: HIPAA configuration/BAA coverage (hipaa-setup), ZDR ("available to qualified accounts on Claude for Enterprise", https://code.claude.com/docs/en/zero-data-retention), Analytics API (1.4.6 tự ghi là Enterprise).
  - **Fix:** Viết lại thành "Team đủ cho lớp *policy kỹ thuật*. Nó không đủ cho xử lý PHI qua Claude Code. Quyết định 'agent không bao giờ thấy PHI' hay 'nâng Enterprise + BAA' là open item." Thêm vào 1.9.
  
  **1.8 #5 — Bước nhảy logic: sandbox `denyRead`/`credentials` không chặn được Read tool, hook hay MCP server.**
  - Quote: "tools such as Read, Edit, Write, WebFetch… follow permission rules instead. A `denyRead` entry doesn't stop the Read tool" và "`sandbox.credentials` affects sandboxed Bash commands only."
  - Env scrub cũng giữ lại `GITHUB_TOKEN`/`GH_TOKEN` (xem 1.6.5).
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing#what-runs-outside-the-sandbox
  - **Fix:** Thêm `Read(...)` deny rules và/hoặc `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`. Hoặc chạy cả process Claude Code trong container/devcontainer (sandboxing#scope). Điểm mấu chốt của ý 5 vẫn đúng: không để prod credentials trên máy.
  
  ### MEDIUM
  
  **1.1.4 — "only one managed source applies" là nói quá.**
  - Có cross-source keys được đọc từ *mọi* admin source: `allowManagedMcpServersOnly`, `deniedMcpServers`, `disableClaudeAiConnectors`, sandbox locks, `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`, `env` (merge theo từng biến).
  - Login keys (`forceLoginOrgUUID`) lấy từ MDM/file. `allowedProviders` lấy giao giữa các nguồn. `managed-mcp.json` được đọc riêng.
  - Quote: "A few keys work differently. Claude Code reads them from every admin source…"
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#keys-read-from-every-admin-source
  - **Fix:** Thêm "…apart from cross-source keys (list)".
  
  **1.1.9 — Thiếu caveat: `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` không đóng được lỗ bypass ở 1.1.7.**
  - Quote: "A session that doesn't fetch server-managed settings starts without waiting."
  - Nghĩa là provider env var hoặc API key của org khác vẫn bypass được.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings#enforce-fail-closed-startup
  - **Fix:** Thêm câu trên. Nhắc thêm rằng nếu `api.anthropic.com` không truy cập được thì CLI không chạy.
  
  **1.1.10 — "if the user rejects, Claude Code exits" chỉ đúng với session interactive.**
  - Quote: "A non-interactive run, such as `claude -p`, an Agent SDK session, or a session in the VS Code extension's chat panel or the desktop app's Code tab: Claude Code can't show the dialog. When the delivered settings would require approval, they apply for that run only."
  - `claudeMd` và các giá trị truthy của `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` không cần approval.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings#security-approval-dialogs
  - **Fix:** Thêm caveat interactive-only và các ngoại lệ trên.
  
  **1.1.11 — "mostly fail closed" là nói quá.**
  - Có nhiều trường hợp fail open:
    - "`requiredMinimumVersion` and `requiredMaximumVersion` fail open by design"
    - `disableAllHooks` không hợp lệ bị bỏ qua
    - `deniedMcpServers`/`blockedMarketplaces` sai toàn bộ thì bị bỏ qua
    - `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` không hợp lệ bị bỏ qua
    - "If the operating system denied the read… every session starts without that source's policies"
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#keys-that-fail-closed
  - **Fix:** Liệt kê các trường hợp fail open. Quan trọng nhất cho thiết kế: một file managed bị đặt sai quyền (OS deny) sẽ làm mất policy mà không có lỗi ở startup.
  
  **1.2.3 + 1.8 #4 — "permission prompts off is the default" sai bản chất.**
  - Auto mode không phải bypass: có classifier kiểm tra trước khi chạy, và ask/deny rules vẫn áp dụng.
  - Quote (security): "A separate classifier model reviews actions instead of you and blocks the ones it judges unsafe… Your explicit ask and deny rules still apply."
  - Bảng starting mode có điều kiện: "`auto` with Claude Code v2.1.283 or later". `-p` thì "`default`". Org có HIPAA config cũng `default`.
  - URL nguồn chính: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes#which-mode-a-session-starts-in
  - **Fix:** "Interactive sessions start in auto mode (classifier-gated, no routine prompts) from v2.1.283", và trích trang permission-modes làm nguồn chính.
  
  **1.5.6 — `allowManagedModsOnly` không phải top-level key, và trang được trích không nhắc tới nó.**
  - permissions.md không có chuỗi `allowManagedModsOnly`.
  - Quote (mods/admin): "The option goes in managed settings under `pluginConfigs`, keyed by `cc-plugin-sec-default@builtin`" → `{"pluginConfigs":{"cc-plugin-sec-default@builtin":{"options":{"allowManagedModsOnly":true}}}}`.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/admin#stop-user-installed-mods-from-loading
  - **Fix:** Sửa cách viết key và nguồn. Thêm hệ quả: một run CI dùng API key hoặc `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` mà không có managed settings thì mod có thể override deny rule. Quote: "A session that runs on an API key or a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` instead isn't using that login". Điểm này củng cố 1.8 #3.
  
  **1.6.2 — "File tools, web tools … run with full access" không chính xác.**
  - File và web tools chịu permission rules; hooks, MCP servers và helpers mới chạy "with your full access".
  - Còn thiếu: mods, LSP, plugin monitors, lệnh gõ bằng `!` và `excludedCommands`.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing#what-runs-outside-the-sandbox
  - **Fix:** Tách thành hai nhóm như trên.
  
  **1.6.5 — Thiếu caveat quan trọng cho CI.**
  - Quote: "it leaves GitHub tokens and proxy settings in place"; "recognizes a credential by its variable name or by the shape of its value".
  - Muốn chặn GitHub token thì dùng `sandbox.credentials` deny.
  - Trang được trích (sandboxing) chỉ nhắc tên biến; chi tiết nằm ở https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars#what-the-subprocess-environment-scrub-removes
  - **Fix:** Thêm các caveat trên và sửa nguồn.
  
  **1.7.2 — Thiếu bằng chứng về việc managed settings có áp dụng trong `--bare` hay không.**
  - Docs nói hook trong settings và plugin không chạy ("Hooks still don't run in bare mode when you pass them with `--settings`…").
  - Không trang nào tôi đọc nói managed hooks, managed permission rules hay sandbox có còn hiệu lực trong bare mode. `claude --help` chỉ nói "skip hooks (those defined in settings and by installed plugins…)".
  - Bare mode "never reads OAuth credentials" → không nhận được server-managed qua OAuth token (server-managed-settings#platform-availability).
  - **Fix:** Đổi marker phần "managed policy in bare mode" sang ⚠️ và thêm vào 1.9 (cần thử trên runner).
  
  **1.7.3 — Thiếu phần còn lại của bức tranh.**
  - Trong `-p`, repo cũng cung cấp được "the `env` block and helper commands such as `apiKeyHelper`… and a project skill's hooks and `allowed-tools`".
  - Ngay cả với `--bare`: "The project's `env` block and helpers such as `awsAuthRefresh` in its settings files still apply".
  - Mitigation có trong docs: `--setting-sources user`, `--settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}'`, `disabledMcpjsonServers`.
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions#what-runs-before-you-trust-a-folder
  - **Fix:** Bổ sung các điểm trên. Lưu ý thêm (xem Gaps): claude-code-action tự khôi phục `.claude/`, `.mcp.json` và `CLAUDE.md` từ base branch.
  
  **1.7.10 (mâu thuẫn với 1.7.6) — "use an org OAuth token" gây hiểu sai.**
  - Token này do một cá nhân tạo bằng `claude setup-token`, "tied to the subscription of the person who ran `claude setup-token`" (github-actions#set-up-for-an-organization).
  - Server-managed page cũng nói: "The OAuth token option doesn't apply to a job that runs with `--bare`".
  - **Fix:** "Docs give two options: a personal OAuth token authorized for the Team org (ties CI to one person; not with `--bare`) or an endpoint `managed-settings.json` on the runner." Sau đó ghi rõ trade-off với 1.7.6.
  
  **1.8 #3 — "baked into CI runner images" chưa xét GitHub-hosted runners.**
  - Quote (github-actions): "the Claude Code GitHub Action runs on GitHub-hosted runners".
  - Trên runner đó không có image riêng. File phải được ghi vào `/etc/claude-code/` trong một step, và nếu agent (Bash) có sudo trong cùng job thì nó sửa được file này. ⚠️ Tôi chưa verify việc GitHub-hosted runner có passwordless sudo.
  - **Fix:** Ghi rõ là cần self-hosted runner hoặc container image, hoặc chứng minh rằng step của agent không ghi được vào `/etc/claude-code`. Đưa vào 1.9.

  - **1.1.7:** Danh sách bypass chưa đủ. Trang còn liệt kê `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS`. Fix: thêm "…and other `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*`".

  6. **`availableModels`/`deniedModels`:** managed `model` "is a starting default, not a lock". https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#settings-precedence
  7. **Hook hardening:** `onFailure: "block"`, `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars`. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks

  # Fact-check Topic 1 (`work/02-research.md` §1.1–1.9)
  
  **Cách kiểm tra:** Tôi tải bản `.md` của các trang chính thức bằng `curl https://code.claude.com/docs/en/<page>.md`. Đó là cùng nội dung với trang HTML, nhưng đọc được đầy đủ, không bị cắt. Ngoài 14 trang file trích dẫn, tôi đọc thêm `permission-modes`, `settings-reference`, `env-vars`, `cli-reference`, `plugins/mods/admin`, `hipaa-setup`, `zero-data-retention` và `monitoring-usage`.   ## Findings
  
  ### HIGH
  
  **1.5.2 — "hooks fail open on crash" được viết như một thuộc tính cố định. Sai cho v2.1.295+.**

  - Quote: "To block the action instead, set `"onFailure": "block"` on a `command` or `http` hook. Requires Claude Code v2.1.295 or later." và "On `PreToolUse`, a timed-out … hook doesn't block the tool call, except for hooks whose failure blocks the action".
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#block-the-action-when-a-hook-fails
  - **Fix:** "Mặc định hook fail open (exit code khác 0/2, không start được, timeout → action vẫn chạy). Set `onFailure: "block"` (v2.1.295+, chỉ cho hook `command`/`http`; không áp dụng cho `Stop`/`SubagentStop`/async hook) để fail closed." Thêm dòng này vào 1.8 và vào `examples/`.
  
  **1.6.6 — Thiếu điều kiện: HIPAA configuration chỉ có trên Enterprise + BAA. Papaya đang ở Team.**
  - Quote (hipaa-setup): "The HIPAA configuration is an organization setting on Claude Enterprise plans, for organizations that handle protected health information (PHI) and have a Business Associate Agreement (BAA)…"
  - Quote (managed-settings): "If your organization has the HIPAA configuration applied, see `settings-hipaa.json`…"
  - Cùng trang: "The Claude Code extensions for VS Code and JetBrains aren't part of (local mode)… your BAA doesn't cover them."
  - URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hipaa-setup
  - **Fix:** Ghi rõ là Enterprise-only + BAA. File example vẫn dùng làm mẫu kỹ thuật được, nhưng nó không biến Team plan thành HIPAA-ready.
  
  **1.8 #2 — "Team plan is enough for the baseline" là bước nhảy logic.**
  - Các dòng 1.1.5/1.1.6 chỉ chứng minh được rằng server-managed settings có trên Team. Chúng không chứng minh baseline cho một công ty bị HIPAA ràng buộc.
  - Trên Team không có: HIPAA configuration/BAA coverage (hipaa-setup), ZDR ("available to qualified accounts on Claude for Enterprise", https://code.claude.com/docs/en/zero-data-retention), Analytics API (1.4.6 tự ghi là Enterprise).
  - **Fix:** Viết lại thành "Team đủ cho lớp *policy kỹ thuật*. Nó không đủ cho xử lý PHI qua Claude Code. Quyết định 'agent không bao giờ thấy PHI' hay 'nâng Enterprise + BAA' là open item." Thêm vào 1.9.

  - `disableAllHooks` không hợp lệ bị bỏ qua
  - `deniedMcpServers`/`blockedMarketplaces` sai toàn bộ thì bị bỏ qua
  - `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` không hợp lệ bị bỏ qua
  - "If the operating system denied the read… every session starts without that source's policies"
- URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#keys-that-fail-closed
- **Fix:** Liệt kê các trường hợp fail open. Quan trọng nhất cho thiết kế: một file managed bị đặt sai quyền (OS deny) sẽ làm mất policy mà không có lỗi ở startup.

**1.2.3 + 1.8 #4 — "permission prompts off is the default" sai bản chất.**
- Auto mode không phải bypass: có classifier kiểm tra trước khi chạy, và ask/deny rules vẫn áp dụng.
- Quote (security): "A separate classifier model reviews actions instead of you and blocks the ones it judges unsafe… Your explicit ask and deny rules still apply."
- Bảng starting mode có điều kiện: "`auto` with Claude Code v2.1.283 or later". `-p` thì "`default`". Org có HIPAA config cũng `default`.
- URL nguồn chính: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes#which-mode-a-session-starts-in
- **Fix:** "Interactive sessions start in auto mode (classifier-gated, no routine prompts) from v2.1.283", và trích trang permission-modes làm nguồn chính.

**1.5.6 — `allowManagedModsOnly` không phải top-level key, và trang được trích không nhắc tới nó.**
- permissions.md không có chuỗi `allowManagedModsOnly`.
- Quote (mods/admin): "The option goes in managed settings under `pluginConfigs`, keyed by `cc-plugin-sec-default@builtin`" → `{"pluginConfigs":{"cc-plugin-sec-default@builtin":{"options":{"allowManagedModsOnly":true}}}}`.
- URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/admin#stop-user-installed-mods-from-loading
- **Fix:** Sửa cách viết key và nguồn. Thêm hệ quả: một run CI dùng API key hoặc `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` mà không có managed settings thì mod có thể override deny rule. Quote: "A session that runs on an API key or a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` instead isn't using that login". Điểm này củng cố 1.8 #3.

**1.6.2 — "File tools, web tools … run with full access" không chính xác.**
- File và web tools chịu permission rules; hooks, MCP servers và helpers mới chạy "with your full access".
- Còn thiếu: mods, LSP, plugin monitors, lệnh gõ bằng `!` và `excludedCommands`.
- URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing#what-runs-outside-the-sandbox
- **Fix:** Tách thành hai nhóm như trên.

**1.6.5 — Thiếu caveat quan trọng cho CI.**
- Quote: "it leaves GitHub tokens and proxy settings in place"; "recognizes a credential by its variable name or by the shape of its value".
- Muốn chặn GitHub token thì dùng `sandbox.credentials` deny.
- Trang được trích (sandboxing) chỉ nhắc tên biến; chi tiết nằm ở https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars#what-the-subprocess-environment-scrub-removes
- **Fix:** Thêm các caveat trên và sửa nguồn.

**1.7.2 — Thiếu bằng chứng về việc managed settings có áp dụng trong `--bare` hay không.**
- Docs nói hook trong settings và plugin không chạy ("Hooks still don't run in bare mode when you pass them with `--settings`…").
- Không trang nào tôi đọc nói managed hooks, managed permission rules hay sandbox có còn hiệu lực trong bare mode. `claude --help` chỉ nói "skip hooks (those defined in settings and by installed plugins…)".
- Bare mode "never reads OAuth credentials" → không nhận được server-managed qua OAuth token (server-managed-settings#platform-availability).
- **Fix:** Đổi marker phần "managed policy in bare mode" sang ⚠️ và thêm vào 1.9 (cần thử trên runner).

**1.7.3 — Thiếu phần còn lại của bức tranh.**
- Trong `-p`, repo cũng cung cấp được "the `env` block and helper commands such as `apiKeyHelper`… and a project skill's hooks and `allowed-tools`".
- Ngay cả với `--bare`: "The project's `env` block and helpers such as `awsAuthRefresh` in its settings files still apply".
- Mitigation có trong docs: `--setting-sources user`, `--settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}'`, `disabledMcpjsonServers`.
- URL: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions#what-runs-before-you-trust-a-folder
- **Fix:** Bổ sung các điểm trên. Lưu ý thêm (xem Gaps): claude-code-action tự khôi phục `.claude/`, `.mcp.json` và `CLAUDE.md` từ base branch.

**1.7.10 (mâu thuẫn với 1.7.6) — "use an org OAuth token" gây hiểu sai.**
- Token này do một cá nhân tạo bằng `claude setup-token`, "tied to the subscription of the person who ran `claude setup-token`" (github-actions#set-up-for-an-organization).
- Server-managed page cũng nói: "The OAuth token option doesn't apply to a job that runs with `--bare`".
- **Fix:** "Docs give two options: a personal OAuth token authorized for the Team org (ties CI to one person; not with `--bare`) or an endpoint `managed-settings.json` on the runner." Sau đó ghi rõ trade-off với 1.7.6.

**1.8 #3 — "baked into CI runner images" chưa xét GitHub-hosted runners.**
- Quote (github-actions): "the Claude Code GitHub Action runs on GitHub-hosted runners".
- Trên runner đó không có image riêng. File phải được ghi vào `/etc/claude-code/` trong một step, và nếu agent (Bash) có sudo trong cùng job thì nó sửa được file này. ⚠️ Tôi chưa verify việc GitHub-hosted runner có passwordless sudo.
- **Fix:** Ghi rõ là cần self-hosted runner hoặc container image, hoặc chứng minh rằng step của agent không ghi được vào `/etc/claude-code`. Đưa vào 1.9.

### LOW

- **1.1.7:** Danh sách bypass chưa đủ. Trang còn liệt kê `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS`. Fix: thêm "…and other `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*`".
- **1.1.13:** Nên thêm rằng `requiredMinimumVersion` fail open khi giá trị không hợp lệ, và có thêm `requiredMaximumVersion` (managed-settings#keys-that-fail-closed).
- **1.2.4:** "since v2.1.257" chỉ được docs gắn cho `bypassPermissions` ("Before v2.1.257, `bypassPermissions` took effect from any file"). Một project đặt `bypassPermissions` thì session "starts in Manual mode" (permission-modes). Fix: chỉ gắn version cho bypass.
- **1.3.1:** Bỏ sót hai pattern "Plugin servers only" (`strictPluginOnlyCustomization` với `mcp`) và "Soft allowlist" (managed-mcp#choose-a-pattern).
- **1.3.6:** Thiếu sắc thái. Quote: "Anthropic reviews connectors against its listing criteria before adding them to the Anthropic Directory, but does not security-audit or manage any MCP server."
- **1.4.1:** Việc pin bằng `ref`/`sha` thuộc trang marketplace-reference; plugin-marketplaces chỉ link tới đó. Fix: đổi marker phần pin sang 📖 hoặc trích marketplace-reference#plugin-sources.
- **1.4.2:** "(managed)" chưa chính xác. Quote: "Every key in the table is a managed setting, apart from `enabledPlugins`, `syncClaudeAiPlugins`…". `extraKnownMarketplaces` không nằm trong control matrix. `disableSideloadFlags` "Doesn't restrict `.mcp.json`, `claude mcp add`".
- **1.5.5:** Nguồn đúng là section "What runs outside the sandbox", không phải "limitations".
- **1.5.7:** Thêm caveat: "Claude Code doesn't run `ConfigChange` hooks when server-managed settings arrive or refresh… a hook can't block a `policy_settings` change" (server-managed-settings#security-considerations).
- **1.7.1:** `--disallowedTools` và `--max-turns` không có trên trang headless; chúng nằm ở cli-reference. `--max-turns` không xuất hiện trong `claude --help` 2.1.319 local ✅. Fix: trích https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference.
- **1.7.4:** Docs nói: "In a `-p` run with no host, these requests are denied either way". Flag này chủ yếu có ý nghĩa khi có `canUseTool`/`--permission-prompt-tool`, và `PermissionRequest` hook vẫn có thể allow.
- **1.7.8:** Hai nguồn chính thức lệch nhau. code.claude.com ghi Actions "Read and write"; action security.md ghi "Actions (Read)" và xếp Workflows RW vào "not yet actively used". Fix: ghi nhận sự khác biệt này.

---

## Coverage gaps (trong phạm vi Topic 1)

1. **`allowedProviders` + `forceLoginOrgUUID`/`forceLoginMethod`** (v2.1.285+). Đây là cách đóng lỗ bypass ở 1.1.7 trên máy có endpoint-managed: session dùng provider không có trong list bị từ chối. Login keys phải đặt trong MDM/file. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#allowedproviders, https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#which-managed-source-supplies-login-keys
2. **Tenant Restrictions** (chặn đăng nhập vào org khác ở tầng mạng). Trang server-managed khuyến nghị. https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13198485
3. **Managed CLAUDE.md qua key `claudeMd`** (Managed scope, không cần approval). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#claudemd
4. **Workspace trust:** `permissions.allow`/`additionalDirectories` của project chỉ áp dụng sau trust dialog; `-p` không có trust. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions#project-allow-rules-and-workspace-trust
5. **`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` / `blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`** (v2.1.314). Đây là cách giới hạn Read/Edit mà sandbox không làm được. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence
6. **`availableModels`/`deniedModels`:** managed `model` "is a starting default, not a lock". https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#settings-precedence
7. **Hook hardening:** `onFailure: "block"`, `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars`. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks
8. **claude.ai connectors:** `disableClaudeAiConnectors`, `allowAllClaudeAiMcps`. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp
9. **Remote Control và cloud sessions:** Owner bật/tắt cho toàn org; có thêm key `disableRemoteControl`. Cloud sessions chỉ nhận server-managed. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#keys-only-a-managed-source-can-set (note)
10. **Telemetry/audit:** khóa OTLP destination qua managed `env`. Nhưng "A developer's setting can still disable a signal", tức là telemetry không phải audit log chống sửa đổi. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage
11. **Kiểm chứng policy:** `/status` (`Setting sources`, `Skipped sources`) và `claude doctor`. Hữu ích cho evidence ISO 27001. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#check-that-a-policy-is-in-force
12. **claude-code-action:**
    - Khôi phục `.claude/`, `.mcp.json`, `CLAUDE.md`… từ base branch trên PR, nhưng `package.json` và Makefile vẫn lấy từ PR head.
    - `claude-code-base-action` không có actor check.
    - "Allowed bots are not checked for repository permissions".
    - `show_full_output` tự bật khi `ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG` bật.
    - Mặc định không tự tạo PR (người dùng tự bấm tạo).
    - Có `include_comments_by_actor`.
    - https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/security.md
13. **Claude apps gateway:** phát managed settings theo IdP group (giải quyết hạn chế "no per-group" của Team) và chạy được với Bedrock. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings#choose-a-delivery-mechanism, https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-apps-gateway
14. **Cờ `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`** có trong local `--help` ✅. **`skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt`** làm bỏ qua cả prompt `.mcp.json` (mcp#project-scope). Nên nêu cạnh 1.2.7.
15. **Cô lập cả process** (devcontainer / sandbox runtime) cho agent containers. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing#scope, https://code.claude.com/docs/en/devcontainer
16. **HIPAA / ZDR / BAA chỉ có trên Enterprise.** Đây là thiếu sót lớn nhất cho một công ty bảo hiểm sức khỏe (xem HIGH ở trên). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hipaa-setup, https://code.claude.com/docs/en/zero-data-retention

---

**Kết luận chung:** Phần lớn các dòng trích đúng docs và marker phù hợp (32/57 OK). Nhưng 1.8 có hai bước nhảy logic nghiêm trọng (Team đủ cho HIPAA; sandbox đủ để chặn credentials). Ngoài ra file bỏ sót `onFailure: "block"`, HIPAA/BAA chỉ có trên Enterprise, và `allowedProviders`; các điểm này sẽ đổi một phần kết luận của thiết kế.

### What runs before you trust a folder

Each row is one kind of content a repository can supply. The columns are the two situations in which you haven't trusted the folder itself: you trusted only a parent folder, or you ran `claude -p` or the SDK there, which never shows the trust dialog. The parent-folder column doesn't apply inside a [nested repository](#project-al

| :- | :- | :- |

| Servers in `.mcp.json`, including ones the repository [approves in its own settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp.md#project-server-approvals-and-workspace-trust) | Claude Code asks you before connecting them. The repository's own approvals don't count | Connected without asking, approved or not. The SDK loads them only
| A [`headersHelper`](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp#trust-a-folder-before-its-headershelper-runs) on a server in `.mcp.json` | Not run until you accept the trust dialog, which appears again naming where the helper is declared. Claude Code connects the server with its static `headers` alone until then | Not run. Claude Code

For the rows that need this exact folder trusted, trust it by hand: set `projects["<path>"].hasTrustDialogAccepted` to `true` in `~/.claude.json`, where `<path>` is the repository root, or the folder itself outside a repository. Claude Code prints the exact key in the debug log line for a skipped subagent hook or inline MCP serv

Before you run `claude -p` in a repository you didn't write, decide what it may run on your machine:

* Pass `--setting-sources user`, or set the SDK's `settingSources` without project settings, so Claude Code reads neither the project's settings files nor its `.mcp.json`
* Start with [`--bare`](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless#start-faster-with-bare-mode) so Claude Code reads no hooks, skills, custom commands, subagents, plugins, or `.mcp.json` servers from the project. The project's `env` block and helpers such as `awsAuthRefresh` in its settings files still apply, and Claude Code reads
* Pass `--settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}'` to [turn hooks off](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md#disable-or-remove-hooks) for that run. Setting it in your user settings alone isn't enough, because the repository's project settings take precedence over yours and can set it back to `false`
* Add a [`disabledMcpjsonServers`](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#disabledmcpjsonservers) entry to reject a `.mcp.json` server by name in every session type

# 02 — Research: what the tools can actually do today

Purpose: ground every later design decision in current, official documentation, not model memory.
Written in English (it will be quoted in `docs/`); short Vietnamese notes where useful.

## Evidence markers used in this file

This step uses the marker definitions the user set for the research phase (they are slightly
narrower than `CLAUDE.md` Rule 1, where ✅ means "verified in this environment"):

| Marker | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| ✅ | I opened and read the official page in this session; the statement paraphrases or quotes it. Where I also checked something on this machine, the line says **(local check)** |
| 📖 | From official documentation, but I did not open the specific page/section this session (e.g. known only from a link or summary), or the behaviour was not tried |
| ⚠️ | Assumption or inference, not confirmed by a source. Says what is needed to confirm it |

Rules: every claim has a link; no setting or feature name is used unless it appears in the cited
page; access dates are given per topic because these products change weekly.

Process (agreed 2026-11-08, see `CLAUDE.md` Rule 4): each topic is checked by an independent
reviewer subagent; review → fix → re-review until no HIGH/MEDIUM findings remain. Each topic ends
with a short review log.

Local environment for reference: Claude Code `2.1.319` (`claude --version`, **local check**).
Many documented features carry a minimum version (e.g. "requires v2.1.259 or later"); Papaya must
pin a minimum client version (see `requiredMinimumVersion` below).

---

## Topic 1 — Claude Code at organization level

**Accessed:** 2026-11-08. Pages (all under `https://code.claude.com/docs/en/`, also read as raw
`.md`): [settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings) ·
[settings-reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) ·
[managed-settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings) ·
[server-managed-settings](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings) ·

### 1.8 What this means for Papaya (inferences — to be used in the design)

These are my conclusions from the findings above, not documented facts:

1. **Policy layer exists and is real, but it is client-side.** Managed settings can lock bypass/auto
   mode, MCP, plugins and hooks (1.1, 1.2). The docs themselves say it is not a security boundary
   (1.1.7, 1.1.8), and some failure modes are silent (1.1.11). ⇒ Compliance's rule ("named human
   approves prod changes") **cannot rest on Claude Code settings**. It must be enforced where the
   agent cannot reach: AWS IAM / GitHub (Topics 2–3). Claude Code settings are a *safety and
   hygiene* layer (fewer mistakes), not the control of record.
2. **Team plan is enough for the technical policy layer, not for PHI.** Team has server-managed
   settings (1.1.5) but not the HIPAA configuration/BAA (1.6.7), ZDR (1.6.8) or the Analytics API
   (1.4.6); settings-change audit on Team is uncertain (1.1.12). ⇒ Either the design guarantees
   that **agents never see PHI/production data** (fits Topic-0 scope: non-prod is synthetic), or
   Papaya moves to Enterprise + BAA. This is a decision for Papaya (open item).
3. **Two delivery paths are needed:** server-managed for laptops; an endpoint `managed-settings.json`
   (+ `managed-mcp.json` if exclusive MCP control is wanted, + `allowedProviders`/`forceLoginOrgUUID`
   to close provider bypasses, 1.1.15) on every machine that runs an agent unattended, because
   server-managed settings do not reach CI (1.7.10) and are skipped when a provider env var is set
   (1.1.7). On **GitHub-hosted runners** there is no image to bake into: the file would be written
   by a workflow step, and the agent step must not be able to rewrite it (⚠️ depends on whether the
   agent step has sudo — check in Topic 3). Self-hosted runners or a container image are cleaner.
4. **Defaults are permissive for this context:** interactive sessions start in auto mode, where a
   classifier — not a human — approves routine actions (1.2.3); sandbox is off (1.6.1); hooks fail
   open (1.5.2); `-p` runs execute repo hooks, `env` and helpers and connect `.mcp.json` (1.7.3).
   Each needs an explicit org setting (`disableAutoMode`, `sandbox.enabled`, `onFailure: "block"`,
   `--setting-sources`/`disableAllHooks` in CI).
5. **Bash deny rules are advisory** (1.2.6), and the sandbox covers only shell commands (1.6.2).
   Keeping prod credentials away from the agent needs several layers: sandbox
   `denyRead`/`credentials` for Bash, `Read(...)` deny rules and `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`
   for file tools, env scrub (which keeps GitHub tokens, 1.6.5), or the whole process in a
   container (1.6.6). The decisive layer is still **no prod credentials on the agent's machine at
   all**, plus IAM on the AWS side.

### 1.9 Open items to verify (Topic 1)

- [ ] 📖 Read the `settings-hipaa.json` example and the Tenant Restrictions article (Topic 5).
- [ ] 📖 Open the settings-reference entries for `allowManagedHooksOnly`,

## Evidence markers used in this file

This step uses the marker definitions the user set for the research phase (they are slightly
narrower than `CLAUDE.md` Rule 1, where ✅ means "verified in this environment"):

| Marker | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| ✅ | I opened and read the official page in this session; the statement paraphrases or quotes it. Where I also checked something on this machine, the line says **(local check)** |
| 📖 | From official documentation, but I did not open the specific page/section this session (e.g. known only from a link or summary), or the behaviour was not tried |
| ⚠️ | Assumption or inference, not confirmed by a source. Says what is needed to confirm it |

Rules: every claim has a link; no setting or feature name is used unless it appears in the cited
page; access dates are given per topic because these products change weekly.

reviewer subagent; review → fix → re-review until no HIGH/MEDIUM findings remain. Each topic ends
with a short review log.

Local environment for reference: Claude Code `2.1.319` (`claude --version`, **local check**).

### 1.8 What this means for Papaya (inferences — to be used in the design)

These are my conclusions from the findings above, not documented facts:

1. **Policy layer exists and is real, but it is client-side.** Managed settings can lock bypass/auto
   mode, MCP, plugins and hooks (1.1, 1.2). The docs themselves say it is not a security boundary
   (1.1.7, 1.1.8), and some failure modes are silent (1.1.11). ⇒ Compliance's rule ("named human
   approves prod changes") **cannot rest on Claude Code settings**. It must be enforced where the
   agent cannot reach: AWS IAM / GitHub (Topics 2–3). Claude Code settings are a *safety and
   hygiene* layer (fewer mistakes), not the control of record.
2. **Team plan is enough for the technical policy layer, not for PHI.** Team has server-managed
   settings (1.1.5) but not the HIPAA configuration/BAA (1.6.7), ZDR (1.6.8) or the Analytics API
   (1.4.6); settings-change audit on Team is uncertain (1.1.12). ⇒ Either the design guarantees
   that **agents never see PHI/production data** (fits Topic-0 scope: non-prod is synthetic), or
   Papaya moves to Enterprise + BAA. This is a decision for Papaya (open item).
3. **Two delivery paths are needed:** server-managed for laptops; an endpoint `managed-settings.json`
   (+ `managed-mcp.json` if exclusive MCP control is wanted, + `allowedProviders`/`forceLoginOrgUUID`
   to close provider bypasses, 1.1.15) on every machine that runs an agent unattended, because
   server-managed settings do not reach CI (1.7.10) and are skipped when a provider env var is set
   (1.1.7). On **GitHub-hosted runners** there is no image to bake into: the file would be written
   by a workflow step, and the agent step must not be able to rewrite it (⚠️ depends on whether the
   agent step has sudo — check in Topic 3). Self-hosted runners or a container image are cleaner.
4. **Defaults are permissive for this context:** interactive sessions start in auto mode, where a
   classifier — not a human — approves routine actions (1.2.3); sandbox is off (1.6.1); hooks fail
   open (1.5.2); `-p` runs execute repo hooks, `env` and helpers and connect `.mcp.json` (1.7.3).
   Each needs an explicit org setting (`disableAutoMode`, `sandbox.enabled`, `onFailure: "block"`,
   `--setting-sources`/`disableAllHooks` in CI).
5. **Bash deny rules are advisory** (1.2.6), and the sandbox covers only shell commands (1.6.2).
   Keeping prod credentials away from the agent needs several layers: sandbox
   `denyRead`/`credentials` for Bash, `Read(...)` deny rules and `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`
   for file tools, env scrub (which keeps GitHub tokens, 1.6.5), or the whole process in a
   container (1.6.6). The decisive layer is still **no prod credentials on the agent's machine at
   all**, plus IAM on the AWS side.

### 1.9 Open items to verify (Topic 1)

- [ ] ⚠️ Is the compliance API / audit-log export for settings changes available on the **Team**
      plan, or Enterprise only? (1.1.12) — needs Anthropic account team.
- [ ] Decision for Papaya: "agents never touch PHI" vs. Enterprise + BAA + ZDR (1.6.7, 1.6.8, 1.8 #2).
- [ ] ⚠️ Do managed hooks / permission rules / sandbox still apply under `--bare`? (1.7.2) — test
      on a runner with a managed-settings file.
- [ ] ⚠️ On GitHub-hosted runners, can the agent step write to `/etc/claude-code/`? (1.8 #3) —
      check GitHub runner docs in Topic 3.
- [ ] 📖 Read the `settings-hipaa.json` example and the Tenant Restrictions article (Topic 5).
- [ ] 📖 Open the settings-reference entries for `allowManagedHooksOnly`,
      `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` before quoting exact semantics in `examples/`.
- [ ] ⚠️ Whether Papaya devices are under MDM (decides if `managed-mcp.json` exclusive control and
      endpoint `allowedProviders` are possible on laptops). Unknown; the design must offer both paths.

### 1.10 Review log (Topic 1)
